filters.security: typed actual incidents only; sports/crime/road-accident/policy noise rejected
filters.gdelt_geocode: synthetic GDELT place labels not trusted; article evidence + quality tiers

event_model.location_policy: multi-source geolocation after incident clustering; unresolved/coarse locations excluded
event_model.compatibility: incident type must match infrastructure category
event_model.geolocation: named place > article city > trusted source coordinate; negated locations rejected; GDELT fallback never upgraded automatically

deduplication.events: exact article dedup then incident-level clustering
deduplication.top_matches: one best match per infrastructure asset
